description: Browse Signed's public angel investor directory: every investor with a public profile, most complete profiles first, optionally narrowed to one sector or one check size. Each result carries the investor's login (for get_investor), what they invest in, the checks they write, their pinned portfolio companies, and whether they take pitches. Use search_investors when you have a name or a keyword.

check_size.description: Only investors writing checks in this range. Takes the slug (10k-25k) or the label ($10K-$25K); list_check_sizes has both.

sector.description: Only investors who list this sector. Takes the slug (devtools, fintech, health); list_sectors has the full set with names.

name: list_investors
